data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts that preferring the best-corroborated theory is 'rational' (mechanism) while explicitly stripping the preference of any forward-looking/predictive content: it is 'a description of survival rather than a prediction of future dominance' (claim). If the sole alleged justification for the preference is past survival, and we are forbidden to treat that as any grounds for expecting future fitness, then the preference has no normative force for action: there is no reason to apply the survivor over any other available option going forward. Calling it 'rational because it is the only one left standing' is question-begging — 'left standing' only redescribes the present state; it does not generate a reason to choose it now. Thus the account either smuggles in a suppressed predictive premise (contradicting its own claim) or fails to justify the preference at all.
